latest.notes: Setup: the first-run card asks for the admin username and password

releases.notes: Setup: the first-run card asks for the admin username and password
Setup: pick your own username, not just the password, when claiming a new appliance
Setup: a freshly flashed appliance no longer asks for a code on its own network — just pick the admin password
Setup: the 'EthOS is set up' notification now appears after claiming the appliance
Setup: a freshly flashed appliance can be claimed in the browser with the code shown on its screen — no HDMI keyboard, no default password
Packages: installing a package again works even after a failed start left its directory behind.
Files: reliable video thumbnails — one video stream at a time, thumbnail work yields to active playback
Packages: Update all — every pending update runs sequentially, each with its own rollback
Downloads: per-package speed limit — a shared bandwidth cap for every part of one multi-part package, picked on the package row
Downloads: per-part Skip/Unskip so a broken volume no longer blocks a package, skipped parts are excluded from extraction and reported as pausedDL to Radarr/Sonarr
Downloads: mirror/hoster failover — extra source URLs, per-source retry budget, cross-host resume reset, mirror indicator in the row
Downloads: auto-extract finished archives, manual Extract for a task or package, delete-after-extract setting; updater survives its own restart
Download Manager: transient failures retry with exponential backoff (permanent errors do not), Retry failed bulk action, and duplicate/skip/overwrite handling for re-added URLs and existing files.

Updates: the root helper survives its own service restart (systemd scope) and refreshes its installed copy; a stuck running job is detected and finalized after a restart instead of blocking every later update.
Download Manager: multi-part archives (part01.rar, r00, zip.001) group into one JDownloader-style package row with aggregate status and package Resume/Pause/Delete.
Download Manager: archive-tools host requirement installs bsdtar (7z/rar extraction) through the root helper when available; optional so installs never fail.
Download Manager: Clear failed removes errored records and their leftover .part data without touching finished files.
Files: download a folder as a ZIP archive from the folder context menu; the UI now says when the archive is being prepared.

Updates can now be installed from Settings → System: signed index, pre-update snapshot, git/pip update as the repo owner, automatic rollback when the service does not come back healthy. Also adds the update status endpoint and helper contract tests.

Update check: Settings → System now shows the running version and whether a newer release is published (signed index). Products renamed: Files, Packages, Videos, Cameras, Downloads, Photos. Public repository, MIT license.
